text:
Maya: Found the gold paperclip! It's under the whiteboard bench. :eyes:
Ronen: No way — that's been missing since the Great Clip Migration of '22. 🙌
Liz: omg bring it to lunch? We need a ceremony.
Maya: proposing a ritual: pass it to the person who refactors the most controversial legacy file this week. :scroll:
ops-bot: Reminder: office keys should not be attached to non-official artifacts. :rotating_light: (policy 3.4.1)
Ronen: @Maya that's tyrannical. also i'm in *dry-cleaning day*.
Liz: quick poll: should the clip be renamed 'Clip of Commitment' or 'The Golden Binder'? react with :one: or :two:
Maya: :one: strongly.
Ronen: :two: for the win.
Liz: ok counting reactions... (jk i'm tallying mentally) Also can we make tiny plaque stickers? @Sam (design)?
Sam (design): I can mock up one. Do we want laser-engraved metal or sticker? :art:
Maya: sticker is more chaotic + cheap.
Ronen: metal. it's a legend, not a sticker.
Liz: consensus = 2 metal, 1 sticker, 1 chaotic mayor. We'll flip a coin.
Maya: coin flipped. metal it is. Also shoutout to @Tasha for finding it (she was leaving bread crumbs of post-its).
Tasha: 😅 I swear the clip lured me with promises of stapling power.
ops-bot: New artifact policy created: artifacts cannot be used as doorstops. -ops
Ronen: can we please get a plaque that says 'Do Not Use As Staple'
Maya: adding to backlog: ticket #artifact-1 'Golden Paperclip Plaque'
Liz: assigning to @Sam (design). Deadline: next all-hands.
Sam (design): on it. Will also design a tiny ceremonial box. 🎁
Maya: also capturing this in lore: 'When the paperclip returns, so does the memecoin.'
Liz: ritual script idea:```
Ceremony of the Golden Paperclip
1) Gather around the kitchen table
2) Say the oath: "I will not hoard office supplies"
3) Pass the clip clockwise
4) Take a photo for the archives
```
Ronen: saved to #lore and my camera roll.
Tasha: proud to be the clip's unexpected shepherd. :sheep:
Maya: ok i'll bring a tiny velvet pouch for the first handoff. See you at lunch. :tea:
